name: SimpleAwait
description: Deterministic, fixed-memory cooperative coroutine library for Arduino using native C++20 coroutines. Coroutine tasks are not RTOS tasks; optional ESP32 idle waiting uses the core's built-in FreeRTOS primitives. Statically allocated scheduler and coroutine frame pool, no heap allocation for coroutine frames, and deterministic failure behavior. First-class targets: RP2040, RP2350 (Arm and RISC-V), and the ESP32 family.
keywords: coroutines, async, await, cooperative, scheduler, asyncio, rp2040, rp2350, esp32
